plan.title: SRC-SCH-011 Close Schedule Drawer Without Saving

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable eRFX functionality required by the scenario.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and use whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Complete the pricing sheet fields needed for the RFQ.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Add one available QA test vendor so the event can publish.

args.goal: On the buyer's single-stage RFQ create screen, open the Schedule Event drawer from the schedule chip, choose the 60 Mins duration, click Back instead of Save Schedule, and stop on the create screen showing the footer schedule still at the default 30 Mins.

steps.note: Perform and verify the unsaved schedule-duration interaction that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Publish the event after closing the schedule drawer without saving.
Assert that publishing succeeded with the unsaved schedule change discarded.
